welcome.title: New here? Let's get your ATAR estimate.
welcome.body: You only need two things for each subject: the course and its final internal mark. It takes about a minute, and nothing leaves this browser.

add.title: Add your first subject
add.body: Type a course name, like maths, chem or English, then pick it from the list.

mark.title: Enter its final internal mark
mark.body: The percentage your school reported for {course}. A best guess is fine for now; you can change it any time.

more.title: Add the rest of your subjects
more.eligible: That's enough for an ATAR. Add any others you take, then see your estimate.

result.title: This is your projected ATAR
result.body: It uses your internal marks as the exam marks for now. Drag the pin on the curve, or move any exam slider, to see what different exam results would do.
